D5/S3/Combinatorics/Graph/Walks/Tropical.name: D5.S3.Combinatorics.Graph.Walks.TropicalSchurElimination.pivot_walks_and_distance
D5/S3/Combinatorics/Graph/Walks/Tropical.signature: theorem pivot_walks_and_distance (W : V → V → ℝ≥0∞) (b : V) (a z : {x : V // x ≠ b}) : (∀ p : Walk a.val z.val, ∃ q : Walk a z, weight (schur W b) q ≤ weight W p) ∧ (∀ q : Walk a z, ∃ p : Walk a.val z.val, weight W p = weight (schur W b) q) ∧ distance (schur W b) a z = distance W a.val z.val
